Re: National Republican Senatorial Committee, et al. v. Federal Election Commission,
et al., No. 24-621

Dear Ms. McNerney:
Pursuant to Supreme Court Rule 30.4, the parties respectfully request an extension of time
for the opening and response briefs in the above-captioned case.
The parties’ proposed schedule reflects our understanding that NRSC will be set for oral
argument in the December sitting.  Under the part ies’ schedule, petitioners and the government
would file their opening briefs on the merits by August 21, 2025; and the Court-appointed amicus
curiae and intervenors would file their response briefs by September 29, 2025.
An extension of time is requested to acco mmodate professional and personal obligations
during the briefing period.  Counsel for all parties have agreed to this proposed extension.
If you have any questions or would like to discuss further, please do not hesitate to call me
at (202) 637-3377.  Thank you for your kind assistance in this matter.
Respectfully,

Roman Martinez
of LATHAM & WATKINS LLP
Court-Appointed Amicus Curiae

cc: Noel J. Francisco, Counsel for Petitioners
